sections.heading: How to roll out AI reception without disrupting your team
paragraphs: Start with after-hours and overflow only, then expand once scripts and services match your clinic. Define which appointments the AI can book, which require a callback, and how urgent symptoms are escalated.
Train staff to review transcripts or summaries each morning. The goal is fewer missed opportunities — not replacing the empathy your in-office team provides in person.
